_note: Set plays, 5 attack and 5 defense per map; no lineups (util is thrown freehand). If you add one that needs a lineup, set "lineup": true. Attack plays list what the play needs (smoke spots, a flash, info, entry routes, flank watch, fake, lurk); defense plays list 5 positions with preferred roles plus util spots. The page hands each job to a player whose agent can do it: smokes are split between controllers, the trap goes to a sentinel, flashes and info to initiators. A job nobody's agent can do is skipped. Spots are 0-1 minimap coordinates.
